title: Flower Frogs
description: Replaces 3 vanilla frogs with cute floral variants. Requires EMF & ETF
body:
This simple resource pack transforms the three vanilla frog variants (temperate, warm, cold) into adorable flower-themed designs.

### What's inside:
![Frog Variants](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c6f2b2d794f30297e0829f98e79e17b361f59de5.png)

### Requirements (Important!)

This pack uses custom entity models and textures, so you need:

- **Entity Model Features (EMF)** – absolutely required  
- **Entity Texture Features (ETF)** – required for EMF to work properly  

> ⚠️ The pack will **not work** without both mods installed. Download them from Modrinth first.

### Features:

- Full replacement of frog models & textures via EMF  
- Works on **Fabric, Forge, and NeoForge**  
- Compatible with any Minecraft version that supports EMF/ETF

---

📦 **Installation:**  
1. Install EMF + ETF  
2. Put this resource pack in your `resourcepacks` folder  
3. Activate it (place it above any conflicting packs)

Enjoy your new floral frogs! 🐸🌷
